recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13563 unless a future PA decision separately reconsiders Location.type cardinality.
issue_request: FHIR-13563 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for STU3 asking to change Location.type from 0..1 because a location can support multiple functions or services, such as OB and GYN care. The resolution was to update the cardinality to support multiple types.
initial_application: Historical commit 3816ab783830bae22e12ff2fae4f21bd94461199 (GF#13563) changed the old source/location/location-spreadsheet.xml Location.type row from 0..1 to 0..*. The current refactored source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml preserves that cardinality with min 0 and max *.
additional_context: Location is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml is in build scope. Later applied Location.type issues FHIR-43181, FHIR-41510, and FHIR-50319 changed binding, value set, short text, and definition details, but did not reverse the 0..* cardinality. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already allows multiple Location.type values and no source edit is needed.
